2105-5144-6968-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-6968-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-6968-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-5075-5268--52.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5075-5268--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Ogre Slumlord triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3899-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

6034-6731-8089.easyPrerequisites:
Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
Your life total is even.
6034-6731-8089.description:
Activate Deepwood Ghoul by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

2034-5003-7939.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cha'DIch Investigator, adding {C}{C}.
When Cha'DIch Investigator dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Cha'DIch Investigator from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Cha'DIch Investigator enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4863-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Revolutionist.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Revolutionist from exile to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

851-3510-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-3510-5702.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

2781-3375-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3249-5173-5542.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

4490-7743.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
4490-7743.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink by any method.
Gain life by any method.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1492-7220.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-7220.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Glamermite.
When Glamermite enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1247-4289-7008.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2438-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

586-5258-5618-5686-6967.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

224-1193-1846-6657-6820.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1193-1846-6657-6820.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Holding priority, activate Overloaded Mage-Ring by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting the Mythos of Illuna spell.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Overloaded Mage-Ring ability, targeting the Mythos of Illuna spell.
Resolve the copy of Overloaded Mage-Ring's ability, copying the Mythos of Illuna spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Mythos of Illuna, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.

380-2438-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities.

193-1283-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-1283-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

225-573-774.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf.
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

509-1267-2392-5548.easyPrerequisites: Silverskin Armor attached to Medomai the Ageless.
509-1267-2392-5548.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-2392-5548.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Truth and Justice's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Idris.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris and Sword of Truth and Justice trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Truth and Justice trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, then putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

2232-2537-4284-4600.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Clone to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Clone onto the battlefield as a copy of Ghalta from your hand.
When Clone enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Clone trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
